Hi all — a few items from Finance side so we can get PO/AR set up cleanly: 

1) Please complete the supplier registration spreadsheet and return with a PDF of the VAT certificate and a copy of the signatory's ID. I attached our standard template for you to fill: "supplier_registration_form_template.xlsx".
2) Banking: include IBAN + BIC and state whether the account is in EUR. For tax withholding checks we need the payee name exactly as registered.
3) Reverse-charge: if Everglobe is VAT-registered in Italy (and the VAT certificate is valid), we will apply reverse-charge on software/services lines where applicable. However, we need the VAT number to validate via the EU VIES service. If VIES returns clean validation, no fiscal representative is required on our side. If VIES is not resolving, we may ask for additional local evidence.
4) PO format: an email PDF is OK; if your legal team requires a signed acceptance we can do DocuSign on request.

Marco — once you return the completed form I will kick off the vendor record creation and assign an internal PO entity. Expected turnaround is 2 business days barring missing fields.

Thanks,
